table.name: TLGNR_CURRENCY_TX
table.description: Currencies. List of currencies which can be handled by Logon, and is a sub-set of the currencies known in SAP.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK tlgnr_currency_bs. For example CHF, EUR, ...

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK tlgnr_lang_bs. For example de, en, ...

column.name: TXT
column.description: Name of the currency CURRENCY_CD in the language LANG_CD
